Mouthpieces are made of black plastic or vulcanite and show signs of aging and use. Suitable for collectors of vintage smoking accessories or for restoration purposes.

281400389.description:
Natural Mineral Collection
Assorted Crystal Geodes and Quartz Clusters
Natural Stone / Mineral Specimens
Largest specimen approximately 3 inches
Unsigned
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, highlighting the geometric beauty of crystalline formations. The lot includes a prominent deep purple amethyst cluster with well-defined terminations, alongside numerous white quartz druzy geodes and clusters. Several specimens exhibit a reddish-orange iron staining, providing a warm contrast to the translucent and opaque white quartz structures. The collection offers a range of geological textures, from hollow geode cavities to solid crystalline matrices.
Comprehensive 30+ piece lot featuring amethyst, quartz, and druzy formations
Natural variations in crystal size, clarity, and host rock matrix across the set
Specimens range in size with the largest piece measuring 3 inches in length
Condition:
Very good condition overall with average wear. The crystal structures remain largely well-defined with typical natural variations in the host rock matrix. All pieces are stable and suitable for display, collection, or educational study.
